title: Implant from a VA surgeon moving under the microscope
place_text: Department of Veterans Affairs, United States

tellings.quote: according to the pathologist it was moving under the microscope under its own metabolism wow yeah and it was removed by a surgeon from the Department of Veterans Affairs from a US veteran who claimed to have a up close and personal contact with the UAP

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about unexplained flying objects, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a small object taken out of a US military veteran's body. He says a surgeon from the Department of Veterans Affairs, the government department that provides care to former service members, removed it from a veteran who claimed a close encounter with a UAP, the official term for an unidentified flying object, and that a pathologist said it moved under the microscope on its own, as if alive. If true, it would suggest something non-human had placed a living device inside a person.
